$comment: Declarative production state for the V3 pronunciation services.
Consumed by scripts/release/pronunciation-v3.ps1. Current revisions and
declared nonsecret settings were rechecked in parselmouth/us-central1 on
2026-09-25. Image-to-source equivalence remains unproved; see the external
acoustic handoff. Historical rollback targets need review before use.
currentRevision is descriptive and is not an action guard in the script.
Invariants encoded below are load-bearing - see docs/plans/2026-08-03-v3-production-issues-and-keepalive-plan.md.

phoneme-recognizer.$accessNote: Only the compute SA may invoke. Never grant allUsers.
phoneme-recognizer.$minScaleNote: null by design. Setting it pins an always-billed instance (~$37/mo) to remove a cold start the keep-alive already covers.

startupProbe.$note: HTTP, not tcpSocket. Gunicorn binds the port in under a second, so a TCP probe marked the instance ready before the model loaded and put the whole ~50s load inside a learner's request.

praat-api.$accessNote: The browser calls this without a Cloud Run identity token. NEVER pass --no-allow-unauthenticated.
praat-api.$timeoutNote: Must clear _V3_HARD_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (80s). At 60s the worker was killed mid-wait and the browser saw 504 on every cold start.

scheduler.$scheduleNote: Every 10 minutes, not 15: Cloud Run reclaims idle instances around the 15 minute mark.
scheduler.$audienceNote: Base service URL. A tagged-revision URL is not a valid audience and yields 401.
